summary: Iteration 26 - UI/UX Redesign Testing of CustomerDashboard and SupplierDashboard. All redesigned dashboards load correctly with zinc/stone color palette, glassmorphism effects (backdrop-blur on sidebar and header), Outfit font for headings, and dark mode support. Verified: sidebar navigation (Hlavní menu, Profil, Faktury), stat cards, accordion tabs on SupplierDashboard, finance widget, mobile bottom navigation, and dark mode toggle.
